question: Do live captions work in Spanish?
slides: Over *500 million* people speak Spanish natively.
description: Captio AI shows live captions in Spanish, and it was made for deaf and hard of hearing people who follow spoken Spanish by reading.
The Instituto Cervantes counted about 520 million native-level Spanish speakers worldwide in 2025.
Captio AI lists support for Castilian, Mexican, River Plate, Caribbean and Andean Spanish.
Captio AI captions of very fast or heavily dialectal Caribbean Spanish can be less accurate than clearer speech.
Adding Spanish as a language hint in Captio AI tells the app to expect Spanish from the first word.
Captio AI captions speech that switches between Spanish and English mid-sentence.
Live Translator in Captio AI translates spoken Spanish and shows the translation next to the original captions.
Spain, Mexico and Argentina each recognize their own sign language in law: LSE, LSM and LSA.
Spanish live captions in Captio AI need an internet connection, and Captio AI does not do sign language.
